title: TablistPlus
description: Pin players to the top of your tab list with color tags. Always know who's online at a glance.
body:
# TablistPins

Tired of scanning through dozens of names just to find one person? TablistPins lets you pin any player to the top of your tab list, color-tagged by role, so your most important players are always visible the moment you open Tab.

## Features

- **Pinned players at the top** — tagged players always appear first, even on servers with 100+ players
- **Color tags** — assign Friend, Enemy, Mod, Ally, or custom tags with your own colors
- **Offline placeholders** — pinned players stay visible even when offline, so you notice the moment they join
- **Inline management** — hold Tab and manage your pins right there, no extra screens
- **Draggable panel** — reposition it anywhere on screen
- **Per-server pins** — your SMP list stays completely separate from every other server
- **Join/leave notifications** — get a HUD toast when a pinned player joins or leaves
- **Quick-pin keybind** — pin whoever just messaged you without opening any menu
- **Import/export** — share your pin lists between machines or with friends
- **Client-side only** — works on any server, no server mod needed

## How to Use

1. Join any server and hold **Tab**
2. Click the pin button to open the management panel
3. Add a player name and choose a tag color
4. That player now appears pinned at the top every time you open Tab

## Requirements

- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
